title: Admin - View Internal Administrators - Functional Test Plan
overview: Functional testing of the Admin User & Role Management - View Internal Administrators feature on the Y4J platform. This page allows Super Admins to view a list of internal administrators with their details (name, email, role, status, assigned date, assigned by, permissions). Covers list display, admin card content, role dropdown visibility, Edit Permissions button, auto-loading behavior, pagination, and navigation.

testCases.title: Admin list loads automatically when page opens
testCases.preconditions: User is logged in as Super Admin. At least one internal admin exists in the system.
steps: Navigate to User & Roles section from the sidebar
expectedResults: The Internal Administrators page loads without requiring any manual action
A list of admin cards is displayed automatically
A 'Showing X admins' count is visible indicating the total number of admins
testCases.postconditions: Admin list is fully loaded and visible

testCases.title: Admin card displays admin name
testCases.preconditions: User is logged in as Super Admin. Admin list is loaded with at least one admin.
steps: Verify the admin name is displayed prominently on the card
expectedResults: Each admin card displays the admin's name as a heading (e.g., 'IvAdmin1', 'Admin Name')
The name is clearly visible and readable
The name is not empty or placeholder text
testCases.postconditions: Admin name is confirmed visible on the card

testCases.title: Admin card displays email ID
testCases.preconditions: User is logged in as Super Admin. Admin list is loaded.
steps: Verify the email address is displayed below the admin name
expectedResults: Each admin card displays the admin's email address (e.g., 'aofted@mailto.plus')
The email is in valid format (contains @ and domain)
The email is clearly visible and not truncated
testCases.postconditions: Admin email is confirmed visible on the card

testCases.title: Admin card displays role label - Super Admin
testCases.preconditions: User is logged in as Super Admin. At least one Super Admin exists in the list.
steps: Find an admin card with Super Admin role
Verify the role label is displayed
expectedResults: The admin card displays 'Super Admin' as the role label
The role label is clearly distinguishable from other card content
The role label is accurate for the admin's actual role
testCases.postconditions: Super Admin role label is confirmed visible

testCases.title: Admin card displays role label - Limited-Access Admin
testCases.preconditions: User is logged in as Super Admin. At least one Limited-Access Admin exists in the list.
steps: Find an admin card with Limited-Access Admin role
Verify the role label is displayed
expectedResults: The admin card displays 'Limited Access Admin' as the role label
The role label is clearly distinguishable from other card content
The role label is accurate for the admin's actual role
testCases.postconditions: Limited-Access Admin role label is confirmed visible

testCases.title: Admin card displays Active status
testCases.preconditions: User is logged in as Super Admin. Admin list is loaded.
steps: Verify the status indicator is displayed
expectedResults: Each admin card displays 'Active' as the status
The status is clearly visible on the card
The status text is readable and not obscured
testCases.postconditions: Active status is confirmed visible on admin cards

testCases.title: Admin card displays assigned date
testCases.preconditions: User is logged in as Super Admin. Admin list is loaded.
steps: Verify the assigned date is displayed
expectedResults: Each admin card displays 'Assigned:' followed by a date (e.g., 'Assigned:2026-05-19')
The date is in a recognizable format (YYYY-MM-DD)
The date is not empty or showing placeholder
testCases.postconditions: Assigned date is confirmed visible on admin cards

testCases.title: Admin card displays assigned by information
testCases.preconditions: User is logged in as Super Admin. Admin list is loaded.
steps: Verify the 'Assigned By' information is displayed
expectedResults: Each admin card displays 'Assigned By:' followed by the assigner's identifier (e.g., 'Assigned By:pv@mailto.plus' or 'Assigned By:System')
The assigner information is not empty
For system-created admins, it shows 'System'
testCases.postconditions: Assigned by information is confirmed visible

testCases.title: Admin card displays assigned permissions
testCases.preconditions: User is logged in as Super Admin. Admin list is loaded with at least one admin who has permissions assigned.
steps: Verify the permissions section is displayed
expectedResults: The admin card displays 'Permissions:' label
Permission tags are shown (e.g., 'Dashboard', 'Partner Management', 'Product Management')
For Super Admins, all permissions are listed (Dashboard, User Management, Partner Management, Product Management, Comment Moderation, Content Management, Analytics)
For Limited-Access Admins, only assigned permissions are shown
testCases.postconditions: Permissions are confirmed visible on admin cards

testCases.title: Admin role dropdown is visible on the page
testCases.preconditions: User is logged in as Super Admin. User & Roles page is loaded.
steps: Observe the filter/toolbar area above the admin list
Verify the 'All Roles' dropdown filter is visible
expectedResults: An 'All Roles' dropdown button is visible in the toolbar area
The dropdown is clickable
The dropdown indicates it can filter admins by role
testCases.postconditions: Role dropdown is confirmed visible and accessible

testCases.title: Edit Permissions button is available on each admin card
testCases.preconditions: User is logged in as Super Admin. Admin list is loaded.
steps: Verify the 'Edit Permissions' button is present on each card
expectedResults: Each admin card has an 'Edit Permissions' button
The button text reads 'Edit Permissions'
The button includes context about which admin (e.g., 'Edit permissions for IvAdmin1')
The button is clickable
testCases.postconditions: Edit Permissions button is confirmed on all admin cards

testCases.title: Page displays correct admin count
testCases.preconditions: User is logged in as Super Admin. Multiple admins exist in the system.
expectedResults: A 'Showing X admins' text is displayed
The count matches the actual number of admin cards visible (or total if paginated)
If paginated, shows 'Showing X to Y of Z admins'
testCases.postconditions: Admin count is accurate

testCases.title: Pagination works when admin list exceeds page limit
testCases.preconditions: User is logged in as Super Admin. More admins exist than can fit on one page (e.g., more than 5).
steps: Observe the pagination controls at the bottom
Verify new admin cards are loaded
Verify original admin cards are shown again
expectedResults: Pagination controls are visible (Previous, page numbers, Next)
Clicking 'Next' loads the next set of admin cards
Clicking 'Previous' returns to the previous set
Page number buttons allow direct navigation
'Previous' is disabled on the first page
The 'Showing X to Y of Z admins' text updates correctly
testCases.postconditions: Pagination navigates correctly through admin list

testCases.title: Page heading and subtitle are correct
testCases.preconditions: User is logged in as Super Admin.
expectedResults: Page heading displays 'User & Role Management'
Subtitle displays 'Manage admin roles, permissions, and access control'
The section header shows 'Internal Administrators' with description 'Manage Super Admins and Limited-Access Admins'
testCases.postconditions: Page headings are correct and informative

testCases.title: Search input is visible and functional
testCases.preconditions: User is logged in as Super Admin. Admin list is loaded.
expectedResults: A search input field is visible in the toolbar area
Placeholder text reads 'Search admins by name or email...'
The search field is editable
testCases.postconditions: Search input is confirmed visible and ready for use

testCases.title: Add Internal Admin button is visible
testCases.preconditions: User is logged in as Super Admin.
steps: Verify the 'Add Internal Admin' button is present
expectedResults: An 'Add Internal Admin' button is visible in the toolbar
The button is clickable
The button has an icon and text label
testCases.postconditions: Add Internal Admin button is confirmed visible

testCases.title: Multiple admin cards display simultaneously
testCases.preconditions: User is logged in as Super Admin. Multiple admins exist (at least 3).
steps: Wait for the admin list to load
Observe the layout of admin cards
expectedResults: Multiple admin cards are displayed on the page simultaneously
Each card is visually distinct and separated from others
Cards are arranged in a consistent layout (list or grid)
All cards show the same set of information fields
testCases.postconditions: Multiple admin cards are displayed correctly

testCases.title: Super Admin permissions show all modules
testCases.preconditions: User is logged in as Super Admin. A Super Admin exists in the list.
expectedResults: Super Admin card shows all available permissions: Dashboard, User Management, Partner Management, Product Management, Comment Moderation, Content Management, Analytics
All 7 permission tags are visible
testCases.postconditions: Super Admin has full permissions displayed

testCases.title: Limited-Access Admin permissions show only assigned modules
testCases.preconditions: User is logged in as Super Admin. A Limited-Access Admin with partial permissions exists.
expectedResults: Limited-Access Admin card shows only the specifically assigned permissions
The number of permission tags is less than the full set (fewer than 7)
Only the permissions that were explicitly assigned are shown
testCases.postconditions: Limited-Access Admin shows correct subset of permissions

testCases.title: Page refresh reloads admin list correctly
testCases.preconditions: User is logged in as Super Admin. Admin list was previously loaded.
steps: Wait for admin list to load
Refresh the page (F5 or browser refresh)
expectedResults: Page reloads and shows loading state briefly
Admin list loads again with the same data
No errors occur during reload
All admin cards are displayed correctly after refresh
testCases.postconditions: Page refresh works correctly without data loss

testCases.title: Navigation to User & Roles from sidebar
testCases.preconditions: User is logged in as Super Admin and on the Admin Dashboard.
steps: From the Admin Dashboard, locate the sidebar navigation
Click on 'User & Roles' link in the sidebar
expectedResults: Clicking 'User & Roles' navigates to the User & Role Management page
The URL changes to /admin/users-roles
The 'User & Roles' link is highlighted/active in the sidebar
The Internal Administrators page content loads
testCases.postconditions: Navigation to User & Roles works correctly

testCases.title: Admin card layout consistency across different roles
testCases.preconditions: User is logged in as Super Admin. Both Super Admin and Limited-Access Admin cards exist.
steps: Compare a Super Admin card with a Limited-Access Admin card
Verify both have the same layout structure
expectedResults: Both card types have the same layout structure (name, email, role, status, dates, permissions, edit button)
The only differences are the role label text and the number of permission tags
Cards are visually consistent in size and spacing
testCases.postconditions: Card layout is consistent regardless of admin role
